newsitem.title: UK: US First Call, Bloomberg in data distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: US First Call, Bloomberg in data distribution deal.

text.p: U.S. research group First Call Corp. said on Wednesday it had agreed to distribute broker research, corporate and earnings data on Bloomberg LP's online systems.
First Call said it expected its data to be available on the U.S. business information group's terminals by the end of the year.
First Call said its service gave access to more than 275,000 equity research reports, charts and graphs in real time. It said 148 brokers worldwide contributed to its service.
First Call said Bloomberg had more than 77,000 installed systems worldwide, serving over 170,000 financial clients.
